outfitRule: Adult 18+ glamour, 100% sexy and alluring on every character, but always graceful and immortal, never vulgar or brothel-like. Sexy comes from elegant xianxia cuts: plunging necklines, bare shoulders and back, high slits, sheer layers, short skirts with stockings. Every outfit MUST carry tiên khí (immortal aura): long floating ribbons, sashes and sleeves, cloud, lotus, crane or phoenix motifs, jade, crystal or gold ornaments, a soft glow of her element qi, hem and hair drifting as if weightless, a poised refined posture. Forbidden: bikini, thong, lingerie or bra-like tops, tiny loincloths, stripper or street-walker look, harem or tribal look, cheap shiny plastic fabrics. No trousers or pants on any character: use slit gowns, qipao, robes or short skirts with stockings and footwear that fit her role. How much skin shows varies with each character's style. Hard limit: never nude, nipples and genitals always fully covered by opaque fabric or metal, never see-through over them. Adult woman's face and body.
faceRule: Every face is beautiful, harmonious and clearly feminine: the listed structure (face shape, jaw, eyes, nose, lips) must be visible but rendered soft and graceful, never masculine, harsh, gaunt or coarse. Ageless immortal beauty at any apparent age: smooth youthful skin, no wrinkles, no nasolabial folds, no under-eye bags, no sagging. All characters have fair, light skin, each with her own undertone (see her Skin line); never dark or tanned skin; the element colour stays in the background and rim light, never tints the skin or floods the whole image.
